material.acceptance_criteria: Command order from walk_pending is ascending caster id on every peer and run (collect and order the keys, as controls.lua on_tick does), or pairs order is made deterministic by the row lua-piccolo-table-hash-random-seed.
material.description: scenarios/moba/spells.lua:214 (also :143,:155 registration only). piccolo tables hash with a randomly seeded ahash (rust/vendor/piccolo/src/table/raw.rs:64), so pairs order differs per peer and per run; when two casters are parked, cmd_cast/cmd_order are issued in different orders on different peers.
